cwe_assessments.review_comment: The function `destroyCurve` incorrectly calls `mpz_clears(NULL);`, providing zero `mpz_t` arguments. This fails to clear the `mpz_t` fields `curve->p`, `curve->a`, `curve->b`, and `curve->q`, causing a memory leak and potentially leaving sensitive cryptographic parameters in memory. Replace the call with `mpz_clears(curve->p, curve->a, curve->b, curve->q, NULL);` to properly clean up all GMP integers before freeing the structure.
